title: Intermediate
description: Understand the main points of clear standard English, handle most travel situations, write simple connected text, tell experiences and give reasons for opinions.

id.title: Menengah
id.description: Memahami poin utama bahasa standar yang jelas, menangani sebagian besar situasi perjalanan, menulis teks sederhana yang tersambung, menceritakan pengalaman dan memberi alasan atas pendapat.

nodes.title: Present Perfect
nodes.summary: Use the present perfect for duration with for/since, give recent news, and choose it over the past simple.
nodes.canDo: Can say how long something has been true, share recent news and choose between present perfect and past simple.

objectives.text: Talk about duration with for, since and How long …?
Choose present perfect vs past simple
Give recent news with the present perfect (I've lost my keys)

commonErrors.wrong: I live here since 2020.
commonErrors.right: I've lived here since 2020.

commonErrors.wrong: I have seen that film yesterday.
commonErrors.right: I saw that film yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: I've worked here since three years.
commonErrors.right: I've worked here for three years.

id.title: Present Perfect
id.summary: Memakai present perfect untuk durasi dengan for/since, kabar terbaru, dan membedakannya dari past simple.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan sudah berapa lama sesuatu berlangsung, berbagi kabar terbaru, dan memilih antara present perfect dan past simple.

objectives.for-since: Membicarakan durasi dengan for, since dan How long …?
objectives.choose-present-perfect: Memilih present perfect atau past simple
objectives.recent-news: Menyampaikan kabar terbaru dengan present perfect (I've lost my keys)

nodes.title: Present Perfect Continuous
nodes.summary: Talk about actions continuing up to now and recent activities with visible results, and choose simple or continuous.
nodes.canDo: Can say how long they have been doing something and explain the visible results of recent activities.

objectives.text: Use present perfect continuous for duration (I've been waiting for an hour)
Explain recently finished activities with visible results (I'm tired because I've been running)
Contrast present perfect simple and continuous

commonErrors.wrong: I am waiting here for an hour.
commonErrors.right: I've been waiting here for an hour.

commonErrors.wrong: I've been knowing her for years.
commonErrors.right: I've known her for years.

commonErrors.wrong: I've been reading three books this month.
commonErrors.right: I've read three books this month.

id.title: Present Perfect Continuous
id.summary: Kegiatan yang berlangsung sampai sekarang, kegiatan yang baru selesai dengan hasil terlihat, dan kapan memakai simple atau continuous.
id.canDo: Bisa mengatakan sudah berapa lama kamu melakukan sesuatu dan menjelaskan hasil kegiatan yang baru selesai.

objectives.use-present-perfect: Memakai present perfect continuous untuk durasi (I've been waiting for an hour)
objectives.recent-results: Menjelaskan kegiatan yang baru selesai dengan hasil yang terlihat (I'm tired because I've been running)
objectives.contrast-perfect-simple: Membedakan present perfect simple dan continuous

nodes.title: Past Simple & Past Continuous
nodes.summary: Combine the past continuous for background actions with the past simple for main events, using when and while.
nodes.canDo: Can describe what was happening when something else happened and set the scene in a story.

objectives.text: Contrast background actions with main events in the past
Link actions with when and while
Combine past simple and past continuous in a story

commonErrors.wrong: I was watching TV when the phone was ringing.
commonErrors.right: I was watching TV when the phone rang.

commonErrors.wrong: While I was walk home, I saw Rina.
commonErrors.right: While I was walking home, I saw Rina.

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday at 8 I watch TV.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday at 8 I was watching TV.

id.title: Past Simple & Past Continuous
id.summary: Menggabungkan past continuous untuk kegiatan latar dengan past simple untuk kejadian utama, memakai when dan while.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan apa yang sedang terjadi saat kejadian lain terjadi dan membangun latar sebuah cerita.

objectives.describe-background-actions: Membedakan kegiatan latar dan kejadian utama di masa lalu
objectives.when-while: Menghubungkan kegiatan dengan when dan while
objectives.combine-past-continuous: Menggabungkan past simple dan past continuous dalam cerita

nodes.title: Past Perfect
nodes.summary: Use had + past participle to show which past event happened first, with by the time, before and after.
nodes.canDo: Can make the order of past events clear when telling a story.

objectives.text: Form the past perfect with had + past participle
Show which past event happened first (When I arrived, the film had started)
Use by the time, before and after with the past perfect

commonErrors.wrong: When I arrived, the film already started.
commonErrors.right: When I arrived, the film had already started.

commonErrors.wrong: She had forgot her bag.
commonErrors.right: She had forgotten her bag.

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I had gone to the market.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday I went to the market.

id.title: Past Perfect
id.summary: Memakai had + past participle untuk menunjukkan kejadian lampau mana yang terjadi lebih dulu, dengan by the time, before dan after.
id.canDo: Bisa memperjelas urutan kejadian di masa lalu saat bercerita.

objectives.form: Membentuk past perfect dengan had + past participle
objectives.sequence-events: Menunjukkan kejadian lampau yang terjadi lebih dulu (When I arrived, the film had started)
objectives.time-linkers: Memakai by the time, before dan after dengan past perfect

nodes.title: Used To
nodes.summary: Talk about past habits and states that are no longer true with used to, didn't use to and Did you use to …?
nodes.canDo: Can describe how their life and habits were different in the past.

objectives.text: Describe past habits and states with used to (I used to live in Bandung)
Make negatives and questions: didn't use to, Did you use to …?
Choose used to or past simple

commonErrors.wrong: I didn't used to like coffee.
commonErrors.right: I didn't use to like coffee.

commonErrors.wrong: When I was a child, I use to live in Bandung.
commonErrors.right: When I was a child, I used to live in Bandung.

commonErrors.wrong: I used to go to Bali last year.
commonErrors.right: I went to Bali last year.

id.title: Used To
id.summary: Membicarakan kebiasaan dan keadaan lampau yang sudah tidak berlaku dengan used to, didn't use to dan Did you use to …?
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan bagaimana hidup dan kebiasaanmu dulu berbeda dengan sekarang.

objectives.past-habits: Menceritakan kebiasaan dan keadaan lampau dengan used to (I used to live in Bandung)
objectives.negatives-questions: Membuat kalimat negatif dan pertanyaan: didn't use to, Did you use to …?
objectives.used-to-vs-past-simple: Memilih used to atau past simple

nodes.title: Future Forms
nodes.summary: Choose will, going to or present continuous for the future, use might/may for possibility, and use a present tense after when.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about plans, arrangements, predictions and possibilities using the right future form.

objectives.text: Choose between will, going to and present continuous
Use might and may for possibility
Use a present tense in future time clauses (when I arrive, not when I will arrive)

commonErrors.wrong: I'll call you when I will arrive.
commonErrors.right: I'll call you when I arrive.

commonErrors.wrong: Tomorrow I go to Bandung with my family.
commonErrors.right: Tomorrow I'm going to Bandung with my family.

commonErrors.wrong: It might to rain later.
commonErrors.right: It might rain later.

id.title: Bentuk Masa Depan
id.summary: Memilih will, going to atau present continuous, memakai might/may untuk kemungkinan, dan present tense setelah when.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan rencana, janji yang sudah diatur, prediksi dan kemungkinan dengan bentuk masa depan yang tepat.

objectives.choose-between-will: Memilih antara will, going to dan present continuous
objectives.might-may: Memakai might dan may untuk kemungkinan
objectives.time-clauses: Memakai present tense dalam time clause masa depan (when I arrive, bukan when I will arrive)

nodes.title: First Conditional & Time Clauses
nodes.summary: Talk about real possibilities and their results with if, unless, as soon as and in case.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about the likely results of actions and plan for what might happen.

objectives.text: Form first conditional sentences
Use unless, as soon as and in case
Talk about likely results and consequences

commonErrors.wrong: If it will rain, we'll stay home.
commonErrors.right: If it rains, we'll stay home.

commonErrors.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you'll miss the bus.
commonErrors.right: Unless you hurry, you'll miss the bus.

commonErrors.wrong: As soon as I will finish, I'll call you.
commonErrors.right: As soon as I finish, I'll call you.

id.title: First Conditional & Time Clause
id.summary: Membicarakan kemungkinan nyata dan akibatnya dengan if, unless, as soon as dan in case.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan akibat yang mungkin terjadi dari suatu tindakan dan bersiap untuk berbagai kemungkinan.

objectives.unless-as-soon-as-in-case: Memakai unless, as soon as dan in case

nodes.title: Second Conditional
nodes.summary: Talk about imaginary situations with if + past and would, give advice with If I were you, and compare first vs second.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about imaginary situations and give advice using If I were you …

objectives.text: Talk about hypothetical situations (If I had more time, I would …)
Give advice with If I were you …
Choose between the first and second conditional

commonErrors.wrong: If I would have more money, I would buy a car.
commonErrors.right: If I had more money, I would buy a car.

commonErrors.wrong: If I have a lot of money, I would travel the world.
commonErrors.right: If I had a lot of money, I would travel the world.

commonErrors.wrong: If I were you, I will talk to her.
commonErrors.right: If I were you, I would talk to her.

id.title: Second Conditional
id.summary: Membicarakan situasi pengandaian dengan if + past dan would, memberi saran dengan If I were you, dan membedakan first vs second.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan situasi pengandaian dan memberi saran dengan If I were you …

objectives.talk-about-hypothetical: Membicarakan situasi pengandaian (If I had more time, I would …)
objectives.give-advice-with: Memberi saran dengan If I were you …
objectives.first-vs-second: Memilih first conditional atau second conditional

nodes.title: Modals: Obligation, Permission & Possibility
nodes.summary: Talk about rules and possibility: must vs have to, had to and will have to, be allowed to, and may/might/could.
nodes.canDo: Can explain rules, obligations and permission in the past, present and future, and say what is possible.

objectives.text: Choose must or have to
Express past and future obligation with had to and will have to
Talk about permission with be allowed to
Use may, might and could for possibility

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I must work late.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday I had to work late.

commonErrors.wrong: We are not allow to smoke here.
commonErrors.right: We are not allowed to smoke here.

commonErrors.wrong: You mustn't come if you're busy.
commonErrors.right: You don't have to come if you're busy.

id.title: Modal: Kewajiban, Izin & Kemungkinan
id.summary: Membicarakan aturan dan kemungkinan: must vs have to, had to dan will have to, be allowed to, serta may/might/could.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan aturan, kewajiban dan izin di masa lalu, sekarang dan masa depan, serta mengatakan apa yang mungkin terjadi.

objectives.had-to-will-have-to: Menyatakan kewajiban di masa lalu dan masa depan dengan had to dan will have to
objectives.be-allowed-to: Membicarakan izin dengan be allowed to
objectives.may-might-could: Memakai may, might dan could untuk kemungkinan

nodes.title: Modals of Deduction (Present)
nodes.summary: Make logical guesses about the present with must be, might be and can't be, based on evidence.
nodes.canDo: Can make guesses about a situation from evidence and show how sure they are.

objectives.text: Use must be, might be and can't be for deduction
Draw conclusions from evidence (The lights are off. They must be out.)
Show different degrees of certainty

commonErrors.wrong: He mustn't be at home – his car isn't there.
commonErrors.right: He can't be at home – his car isn't there.

commonErrors.wrong: She must to be tired.
commonErrors.right: She must be tired.

commonErrors.wrong: That can be Rina's bag – it's red.
commonErrors.right: That might be Rina's bag – it's red.

id.title: Modal untuk Menyimpulkan (Masa Kini)
id.summary: Membuat dugaan logis tentang masa kini dengan must be, might be dan can't be berdasarkan bukti.
id.canDo: Bisa menduga suatu situasi dari bukti dan menunjukkan seberapa yakin kamu.

objectives.must-might-cant-be: Memakai must be, might be dan can't be untuk menyimpulkan
objectives.infer-from-evidence: Menarik kesimpulan dari bukti (The lights are off. They must be out.)

nodes.title: Passive (Present & Past)
nodes.summary: Form the present and past simple passive, name the doer with by, and know when the passive is the better choice.
nodes.canDo: Can describe processes and events when the action matters more than who did it.

objectives.text: Form the passive with is/are + past participle and was/were + past participle
Say who did the action with by
Decide when to use the passive

commonErrors.wrong: The office cleaned every day.
commonErrors.right: The office is cleaned every day.

commonErrors.wrong: This house was build in 1990.
commonErrors.right: This house was built in 1990.

commonErrors.wrong: The novel was written from Pramoedya.
commonErrors.right: The novel was written by Pramoedya.

id.title: Passive (Present & Past)
id.summary: Membentuk passive present dan past simple, menyebut pelaku dengan by, dan tahu kapan passive lebih tepat.
id.canDo: Bisa mendeskripsikan proses dan kejadian ketika tindakannya lebih penting daripada pelakunya.

objectives.form-passive: Membentuk passive dengan is/are + V3 dan was/were + V3

nodes.title: Reported Speech (Intro)
nodes.summary: Report what people said with say and tell, changing tenses, pronouns and time words.
nodes.canDo: Can pass on what someone else said in a conversation or message.

objectives.text: Choose say or tell (She told me …, She said that …)
Change tenses when reporting (am → was, will → would)
Change pronouns and time words (tomorrow → the next day)

commonErrors.wrong: She said me that she was tired.
commonErrors.right: She told me that she was tired.

commonErrors.wrong: He told that he was busy.
commonErrors.right: He said that he was busy.

commonErrors.wrong: (reporting a week later) She said she will come tomorrow.
commonErrors.right: She said she would come the next day.

id.title: Reported Speech (Pengantar)
id.summary: Melaporkan ucapan orang lain dengan say dan tell, mengubah tense, kata ganti dan keterangan waktu.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan ulang apa yang dikatakan orang lain dalam percakapan atau pesan.

objectives.say-vs-tell: Memilih say atau tell (She told me …, She said that …)
objectives.tense-backshift: Mengubah tense saat melaporkan ucapan (am → was, will → would)
objectives.pronouns-time-words: Mengubah kata ganti dan keterangan waktu (tomorrow → the next day)

nodes.title: Relative Clauses
nodes.summary: Join ideas with defining relative clauses using who, which, that and where, and drop the pronoun when you can.
nodes.canDo: Can give extra information about people, things and places in one connected sentence.

objectives.text: Join ideas with defining relative clauses
Choose who, which, that or where
Leave out the relative pronoun when it is the object (the book I bought)

commonErrors.wrong: The man which lives next door is a doctor.
commonErrors.right: The man who lives next door is a doctor.

commonErrors.wrong: This is the book that I bought it yesterday.
commonErrors.right: This is the book that I bought yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: That's the office which I work.
commonErrors.right: That's the office where I work.

id.title: Relative Clauses
id.summary: Menggabungkan ide dengan defining relative clause memakai who, which, that dan where, serta menghilangkan kata ganti bila bisa.
id.canDo: Bisa memberi informasi tambahan tentang orang, benda dan tempat dalam satu kalimat yang tersambung.

objectives.join-ideas-with: Menggabungkan ide dengan defining relative clause
objectives.choose-who-which: Memilih who, which, that atau where
objectives.omit-pronoun: Menghilangkan relative pronoun ketika berfungsi sebagai objek (the book I bought)

nodes.title: Gerunds & Infinitives
nodes.summary: Learn which verbs take -ing or to + infinitive, and use the -ing form as a subject and after prepositions.
nodes.canDo: Can combine verbs correctly to talk about plans, preferences and interests.

objectives.text: Use verbs followed by -ing (avoid, suggest, consider)
Use verbs followed by to + infinitive (decide, plan, afford)
Use -ing forms as subjects and after prepositions (interested in learning)

commonErrors.wrong: I'm interested in learn English.
commonErrors.right: I'm interested in learning English.

commonErrors.wrong: She suggested to go by train.
commonErrors.right: She suggested going by train.

commonErrors.wrong: We can't afford buying a car.
commonErrors.right: We can't afford to buy a car.

id.title: Gerund & Infinitive
id.summary: Mempelajari kata kerja yang diikuti -ing atau to + infinitive, serta memakai bentuk -ing sebagai subjek dan setelah preposisi.
id.canDo: Bisa menggabungkan kata kerja dengan benar untuk membicarakan rencana, preferensi dan minat.

objectives.use-verbs-followed: Memakai kata kerja yang diikuti -ing (avoid, suggest, consider)
objectives.use-verbs-followed-2: Memakai kata kerja yang diikuti to + infinitive (decide, plan, afford)
objectives.gerund-subject-preposition: Memakai bentuk -ing sebagai subjek dan setelah preposisi (interested in learning)

nodes.title: So, Such, Too & Enough
nodes.summary: Express degree and result with so/such … that, too + adjective and (not) adjective + enough.
nodes.canDo: Can explain why something is or isn't possible by describing how much of a quality it has.

objectives.text: Use so and such … that for results (It was so hot that …)
Use too + adjective (+ to) for problems (too tired to drive)
Use (not) adjective + enough (old enough, not big enough)

commonErrors.wrong: This bag is too much expensive.
commonErrors.right: This bag is too expensive.

commonErrors.wrong: He is enough old to drive.
commonErrors.right: He is old enough to drive.

commonErrors.wrong: It was so a good film.
commonErrors.right: It was such a good film.

id.title: So, Such, Too & Enough
id.summary: Menyatakan tingkat dan akibat dengan so/such … that, too + kata sifat, dan (not) kata sifat + enough.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan mengapa sesuatu bisa atau tidak bisa terjadi dengan menggambarkan tingkat suatu sifat.

objectives.so-such-that: Memakai so dan such … that untuk akibat (It was so hot that …)
objectives.too-adjective: Memakai too + kata sifat (+ to) untuk masalah (too tired to drive)
objectives.adjective-enough: Memakai (not) kata sifat + enough (old enough, not big enough)

nodes.title: Indirect Questions & Question Tags
nodes.summary: Ask polite indirect questions and use basic question tags to check information or invite agreement.
nodes.canDo: Can ask for information politely and check that they have understood correctly.

objectives.text: Ask indirect questions (Could you tell me where the station is?)
Use basic question tags (isn't it?, don't you?)
Use both to sound polite in conversation

commonErrors.wrong: Could you tell me where is the station?
commonErrors.right: Could you tell me where the station is?

commonErrors.wrong: You're from Jakarta, isn't it?
commonErrors.right: You're from Jakarta, aren't you?

commonErrors.wrong: Do you know what time does it start?
commonErrors.right: Do you know what time it starts?

id.title: Indirect Question & Question Tag
id.summary: Mengajukan pertanyaan tidak langsung yang sopan dan memakai question tag dasar untuk memastikan informasi.
id.canDo: Bisa meminta informasi dengan sopan dan memastikan kamu sudah memahami dengan benar.

objectives.indirect-questions: Mengajukan indirect question (Could you tell me where the station is?)
objectives.question-tags: Memakai question tag dasar (isn't it?, don't you?)
objectives.polite-use: Memakai keduanya agar terdengar sopan dalam percakapan

nodes.title: Linking Contrast, Reason & Purpose
nodes.summary: Connect ideas with although, even though, however, because of, due to, so that and in order to.
nodes.canDo: Can link ideas to show contrast, reasons and purpose in speech and writing.

objectives.text: Show contrast with although, even though and however
Give reasons with because of and due to
Express purpose with so that and in order to

commonErrors.wrong: Although it was raining, but we went out.
commonErrors.right: Although it was raining, we went out.

commonErrors.wrong: Because of it was late, I took a taxi.
commonErrors.right: Because it was late, I took a taxi.

commonErrors.wrong: I study hard for pass the exam.
commonErrors.right: I study hard in order to pass the exam.

id.title: Kata Penghubung: Kontras, Alasan & Tujuan
id.summary: Menghubungkan ide dengan although, even though, however, because of, due to, so that dan in order to.
id.canDo: Bisa menghubungkan ide untuk menunjukkan kontras, alasan dan tujuan saat berbicara dan menulis.

objectives.contrast-linkers: Menunjukkan kontras dengan although, even though dan however
objectives.reason-linkers: Memberi alasan dengan because of dan due to
objectives.purpose-linkers: Menyatakan tujuan dengan so that dan in order to

nodes.title: Everyday Phrasal Verbs
nodes.summary: Understand and use common everyday phrasal verbs, including separable ones like turn it off.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and use common phrasal verbs in everyday conversation.

objectives.text: Understand common phrasal verbs
Use phrasal verbs in everyday sentences
Put object pronouns inside separable phrasal verbs (turn it off)

commonErrors.wrong: Please turn off it.
commonErrors.right: Please turn it off.

commonErrors.wrong: I'm looking my keys.
commonErrors.right: I'm looking for my keys.

commonErrors.wrong: I gave up to smoke last year.
commonErrors.right: I gave up smoking last year.

id.title: Phrasal Verb Sehari-hari
id.summary: Memahami dan memakai phrasal verb sehari-hari yang umum, termasuk yang bisa dipisah seperti turn it off.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan memakai phrasal verb umum dalam percakapan sehari-hari.

objectives.use-phrasal-verbs: Menggunakan phrasal verb dalam kalimat sehari-hari
objectives.separable-phrasal-verbs: Menempatkan kata ganti objek di tengah phrasal verb yang bisa dipisah (turn it off)

nodes.title: Word Formation Basics
nodes.summary: Build new words with prefixes and suffixes and recognise word families like decide, decision and decisive.
nodes.canDo: Can build and recognise related words to expand their vocabulary and guess meanings.

objectives.text: Use the prefixes un-, dis- and re-
Use the suffixes -er, -tion, -ment, -ful and -less
Recognise and use word families (decide / decision / decisive)

commonErrors.wrong: He is very unhonest.
commonErrors.right: He is very dishonest.

commonErrors.wrong: I made a decide.
commonErrors.right: I made a decision.

commonErrors.wrong: The event was very success.
commonErrors.right: The event was very successful.

id.title: Dasar Pembentukan Kata
id.summary: Membentuk kata baru dengan prefix dan suffix serta mengenali keluarga kata seperti decide, decision dan decisive.
id.canDo: Bisa membentuk dan mengenali kata yang berkaitan untuk memperluas kosakata dan menebak arti.

objectives.prefixes: Memakai prefix un-, dis- dan re-
objectives.word-families: Mengenali dan memakai keluarga kata (decide / decision / decisive)

nodes.title: Make/Do, Say/Tell & Common Collocations
nodes.summary: Choose the right word partners: make vs do, say/tell/speak/talk, and have/take/get + noun.
nodes.canDo: Can use common word combinations naturally instead of translating word for word.

objectives.text: Choose make or do (make a mistake, do homework)
Choose say, tell, speak or talk
Use have, take and get + noun (take a photo, have a rest)

commonErrors.wrong: I have to make my homework.
commonErrors.right: I have to do my homework.

commonErrors.wrong: Can you say me the answer?
commonErrors.right: Can you tell me the answer?

commonErrors.wrong: Let's make a photo.
commonErrors.right: Let's take a photo.

id.title: Make/Do, Say/Tell & Kolokasi Umum
id.summary: Memilih pasangan kata yang tepat: make vs do, say/tell/speak/talk, dan have/take/get + kata benda.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai kombinasi kata yang umum secara alami, bukan menerjemahkan kata per kata.

objectives.make-vs-do: Memilih make atau do (make a mistake, do homework)
objectives.say-tell-speak-talk: Memilih say, tell, speak atau talk
objectives.have-take-get: Memakai have, take dan get + kata benda (take a photo, have a rest)

nodes.title: Feelings, Relationships & -ed/-ing Adjectives
nodes.summary: Describe feelings and relationships, and choose between -ed and -ing adjectives like bored and boring.
nodes.canDo: Can describe their feelings and talk about family and relationships in some detail.

objectives.text: Choose -ed or -ing adjectives (bored vs boring)
Use a range of words for emotions
Talk about relationships and family (get on with, close, divorced)

commonErrors.wrong: I'm very boring in this class.
commonErrors.right: I'm very bored in this class.

commonErrors.wrong: The news was very shocked.
commonErrors.right: The news was very shocking.

commonErrors.wrong: I'm interesting in music.
commonErrors.right: I'm interested in music.

id.title: Perasaan, Hubungan & Kata Sifat -ed/-ing
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan perasaan dan hubungan, serta memilih kata sifat -ed atau -ing seperti bored dan boring.
id.canDo: Bisa mendeskripsikan perasaanmu dan membicarakan keluarga serta hubungan dengan cukup rinci.

objectives.ed-ing-adjectives: Memilih kata sifat -ed atau -ing (bored vs boring)
objectives.relationships: Membicarakan hubungan dan keluarga (get on with, close, divorced)

nodes.title: Careers & Education
nodes.summary: Talk about careers, job applications, education systems and university life, plus skills and qualifications.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about their studies, work experience, skills and career plans.

objectives.text: Talk about careers and applying for jobs
Describe education systems and university life
Describe skills and qualifications

commonErrors.wrong: I want to apply a job at a bank.
commonErrors.right: I want to apply for a job at a bank.

commonErrors.wrong: I have many experiences in marketing.
commonErrors.right: I have a lot of experience in marketing.

commonErrors.wrong: I'm good in English.
commonErrors.right: I'm good at English.

id.title: Karier & Pendidikan
id.summary: Membicarakan karier, lamaran kerja, sistem pendidikan dan kuliah, serta kemampuan dan kualifikasi.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan pendidikan, pengalaman kerja, kemampuan dan rencana kariermu.

objectives.education-university: Mendeskripsikan sistem pendidikan dan kehidupan kuliah

nodes.title: Media & Technology
nodes.summary: Talk about the internet, social media, devices and technical problems, and follow the news.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about how they use technology and media and describe simple technical problems.

objectives.text: Talk about the internet and social media
Describe devices and technical problems (crash, update, log in)
Use vocabulary for news and current events

commonErrors.wrong: My laptop is error.
commonErrors.right: My laptop isn't working. / My laptop shows an error.

commonErrors.wrong: I can't login to the app.
commonErrors.right: I can't log in to the app.

commonErrors.wrong: The video is very viral.
commonErrors.right: The video went viral.

id.title: Media & Teknologi
id.summary: Membicarakan internet, media sosial, perangkat dan masalah teknis, serta mengikuti berita.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan cara kamu memakai teknologi dan media serta menjelaskan masalah teknis sederhana.

objectives.devices-tech-problems: Mendeskripsikan perangkat dan masalah teknis (crash, update, log in)
objectives.news: Memakai kosakata berita dan peristiwa terkini

nodes.title: Environment & Tourism
nodes.summary: Talk about basic environmental issues, tourism and culture, and extreme weather.
nodes.canDo: Can discuss environmental problems, tourism and extreme weather in simple terms.

objectives.text: Talk about basic environmental issues (pollution, recycle)
Talk about tourism and culture
Describe extreme weather (flood, drought, heatwave)

commonErrors.wrong: We must recycling plastic.
commonErrors.right: We must recycle plastic.

commonErrors.wrong: Many tourist come to Bali every year.
commonErrors.right: Many tourists come to Bali every year.

id.title: Lingkungan & Pariwisata
id.summary: Membicarakan isu lingkungan dasar, pariwisata dan budaya, serta cuaca ekstrem.
id.canDo: Bisa membahas masalah lingkungan, pariwisata dan cuaca ekstrem secara sederhana.

nodes.title: Rhythm & Intonation
nodes.summary: Practise the stress-timed rhythm of English and rising or falling intonation for lists, question tags and emotions.
nodes.canDo: Can speak with a natural rhythm and use intonation to check information, list things and show feelings.

objectives.text: Speak with stress-timed rhythm, stressing content words
Use rising and falling intonation in lists and question tags
Use intonation to show emotions (surprise, interest, annoyance)

commonErrors.wrong: Every syllable said with the same length and stress, as in Indonesian
commonErrors.right: Stress the content words and shorten the rest: I WANT to GO to the SHOP

commonErrors.wrong: It's hot, isn't it? with a rising tag when you expect agreement
commonErrors.right: Falling tag when you expect agreement; rising tag when you are really asking

commonErrors.wrong: Flat intonation that sounds bored or rude
commonErrors.right: A wider pitch range to sound interested and friendly (Really?!)

id.title: Ritme & Intonasi
id.summary: Melatih ritme bahasa Inggris yang stress-timed serta intonasi naik dan turun untuk daftar, question tag dan emosi.
id.canDo: Bisa berbicara dengan ritme yang alami dan memakai intonasi untuk memastikan informasi, menyebut daftar dan menunjukkan perasaan.

objectives.stress-timed-rhythm: Berbicara dengan ritme stress-timed dengan menekan kata isi
objectives.lists-question-tags: Memakai intonasi naik dan turun pada daftar dan question tag
objectives.intonation-emotion: Memakai intonasi untuk menunjukkan emosi (terkejut, tertarik, kesal)

nodes.title: Consonant Clusters & Word Families
nodes.summary: Pronounce final consonant clusters, tell minimal pairs apart, and shift stress within word families.
nodes.canDo: Can pronounce consonant groups and similar sounds clearly enough to be understood without effort.

objectives.text: Pronounce final consonant clusters (asked, months, texts)
Distinguish minimal pairs (live/leave, fan/van)
Shift stress in word families (PHOtograph → phoTOgraphy)

commonErrors.wrong: asked said as 'ask' or 'as' (final consonants dropped)
commonErrors.right: asked ending in /skt/, with every consonant pronounced

commonErrors.wrong: van said as 'fan' (/v/ → /f/)
commonErrors.right: van with /v/: top teeth on the lower lip, voice on

commonErrors.wrong: live and leave said the same way
commonErrors.right: live with short /ɪ/, leave with long /iː/

id.title: Gugus Konsonan & Keluarga Kata
id.summary: Melafalkan gugus konsonan di akhir kata, membedakan minimal pairs, dan menggeser stress dalam keluarga kata.
id.canDo: Bisa melafalkan gugus konsonan dan bunyi yang mirip dengan cukup jelas sehingga mudah dipahami.

objectives.final-clusters: Melafalkan gugus konsonan di akhir kata (asked, months, texts)
objectives.stress-shift: Menggeser stress dalam keluarga kata (PHOtograph → phoTOgraphy)

nodes.title: Listening for Main Points
nodes.summary: Follow the main points of clear standard speech about work, school and hobbies, including news and podcasts, and take notes.
nodes.canDo: Can understand the main points of clear speech on familiar topics, including simple news reports and podcasts.

objectives.text: Identify the main points of clear standard speech about work, school and hobbies
Follow clearly spoken news reports and podcasts
Take notes on key information

id.title: Menyimak Poin Utama
id.summary: Memahami poin utama ucapan standar yang jelas tentang kerja, sekolah dan hobi, termasuk berita dan podcast, sambil mencatat.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami poin utama ucapan yang jelas tentang topik yang familiar, termasuk berita dan podcast sederhana.

objectives.main-points: Menangkap poin utama ucapan standar yang jelas tentang kerja, sekolah dan hobi
objectives.news-podcasts: Mengikuti berita dan podcast yang diucapkan dengan jelas

nodes.title: Reading Articles & Opinions
nodes.summary: Read articles and opinion pieces: skim for the gist, separate main ideas from details, and tell facts from opinions.
nodes.canDo: Can understand the main ideas of straightforward articles and tell facts from the writer's opinions.

objectives.text: Separate the main idea from supporting details
Tell facts from opinions
Skim a text quickly for the gist

id.title: Membaca Artikel & Opini
id.summary: Membaca artikel dan opini: skimming untuk inti, memisahkan ide pokok dari detail, dan membedakan fakta dari opini.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami ide pokok artikel yang lugas dan membedakan fakta dari opini penulis.

objectives.main-idea-details: Memisahkan ide pokok dari detail pendukung
objectives.skimming: Membaca cepat (skimming) untuk menangkap inti teks

nodes.title: Telling Stories
nodes.summary: Tell stories and personal experiences in order, with details, reactions and narrative tenses.
nodes.canDo: Can tell a story or describe an experience in a clear sequence, with details and feelings.

objectives.text: Narrate events with sequencing words
Add detail and reactions to a story
Use narrative tenses (past simple, past continuous, past perfect)

commonErrors.wrong: Yesterday I go to the beach and I see a turtle.
commonErrors.right: Yesterday I went to the beach and I saw a turtle.

id.title: Bercerita
id.summary: Menceritakan kisah dan pengalaman secara berurutan, dengan detail, reaksi dan narrative tenses.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan kisah atau pengalaman secara runtut, lengkap dengan detail dan perasaan.

objectives.add-detail-and: Menambahkan detail dan reaksi ke dalam cerita
objectives.narrative-tenses: Memakai narrative tenses (past simple, past continuous, past perfect)

nodes.title: Giving Opinions
nodes.summary: Give and justify your opinions, and agree or disagree politely.
nodes.canDo: Can give their opinion with reasons and respond politely to other people's views.

objectives.text: Express and justify opinions
Agree and disagree politely

commonErrors.wrong: I am agree with you.
commonErrors.right: I agree with you.

id.title: Menyampaikan Pendapat
id.summary: Menyampaikan pendapat beserta alasannya, serta menyatakan setuju atau tidak setuju dengan sopan.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan pendapat beserta alasannya dan menanggapi pandangan orang lain dengan sopan.

objectives.express-and-justify: Menyampaikan dan memberi alasan atas pendapat
objectives.agree-and-disagree: Menyatakan setuju dan tidak setuju dengan sopan

nodes.title: Problems, Complaints & Phone Calls
nodes.summary: Explain problems, make polite complaints, ask for solutions, and handle phone and video calls.
nodes.canDo: Can explain a problem, complain politely and handle phone or video calls in familiar situations.

objectives.text: Explain a problem clearly
Complain politely and ask for a solution
Handle phone and video calls (Could I speak to …?, I'll call you back)

commonErrors.wrong: Hello, I am Budi. Can I speak with Mr Andi?
commonErrors.right: Hello, this is Budi. Could I speak to Mr Andi, please?

id.title: Masalah, Komplain & Telepon
id.summary: Menjelaskan masalah, menyampaikan komplain dengan sopan, meminta solusi, serta menangani telepon dan video call.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan masalah, komplain dengan sopan, dan menangani telepon atau video call dalam situasi yang familiar.

objectives.polite-complaints: Menyampaikan komplain dengan sopan dan meminta solusi
objectives.phone-video-calls: Menangani telepon dan video call (Could I speak to …?, I'll call you back)

nodes.title: Writing Emails
nodes.summary: Write clear, polite emails with the right structure and tone for personal or semi-formal readers.
nodes.canDo: Can write clear personal and semi-formal emails that give news, ask for things and reply to requests.

objectives.text: Structure an email with greeting, purpose and closing
Make polite requests in writing
Adapt the style for personal and semi-formal emails

commonErrors.wrong: I want to ask the schedule. Send me soon.
commonErrors.right: I would like to ask about the schedule. Could you send it to me, please?

id.title: Menulis Email
id.summary: Menulis email yang jelas dan sopan dengan struktur dan gaya yang tepat untuk pembaca personal atau semi-formal.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis email personal dan semi-formal yang jelas untuk memberi kabar, meminta sesuatu dan menanggapi permintaan.

objectives.structure-an-email: Menyusun email dengan salam, tujuan dan penutup
objectives.personal-vs-semi-formal: Menyesuaikan gaya untuk email personal dan semi-formal

nodes.title: Stories & Short Articles
nodes.summary: Write a story of about 100 words with narrative tenses, plus short articles or reviews with clear paragraphs.
nodes.canDo: Can write a short connected story, article or review with clear paragraphs.

objectives.text: Write a story of about 100 words using narrative tenses
Write a short article or review
Build each paragraph around a clear topic sentence

id.title: Cerita & Artikel Pendek
id.summary: Menulis cerita sekitar 100 kata dengan narrative tenses, serta artikel atau review pendek dengan paragraf yang jelas.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis cerita, artikel atau review pendek yang tersambung dengan paragraf yang jelas.

objectives.write-story: Menulis cerita sekitar 100 kata dengan narrative tenses
objectives.topic-sentences: Menyusun setiap paragraf di sekitar topic sentence yang jelas

nodes.title: Summarising & Explaining
nodes.summary: Summarise short texts and conversations for others, and explain Indonesian sources, terms and culture in English.
nodes.canDo: Can summarise short texts for someone else and explain Indonesian information and culture in simple English.

objectives.text: Summarise a short text or conversation for someone else
Explain Indonesian sources in English (rules, menus, news)
Explain Indonesian terms and culture (e.g. mudik, arisan)

id.title: Meringkas & Menjelaskan
id.summary: Meringkas teks dan percakapan pendek untuk orang lain, serta menjelaskan sumber, istilah dan budaya Indonesia dalam bahasa Inggris.
id.canDo: Bisa meringkas teks pendek untuk orang lain dan menjelaskan informasi serta budaya Indonesia dalam bahasa Inggris sederhana.

objectives.summarise-for-others: Meringkas teks atau percakapan pendek untuk orang lain
objectives.explain-indonesian-sources: Menjelaskan isi sumber berbahasa Indonesia dalam bahasa Inggris (aturan, menu, berita)
objectives.explain-terms-culture: Menjelaskan istilah dan budaya Indonesia (misalnya mudik, arisan)

nodes.title: B1 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: A mixed test of every B1 strand in a format similar to B1 Preliminary.
nodes.canDo: Can show B1-level grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, speaking and writing in one mixed test.

objectives.text: Grammar and vocabulary from all B1 nodes
Reading and listening with new texts and audio
Writing (an email and a story or article of about 100 words) and speaking tasks
Score at least 70 in every strand and 80 on average

id.title: Checkpoint B1
id.summary: Tes campuran semua strand B1 dengan format mirip B1 Preliminary.
id.canDo: Bisa menunjukkan kemampuan grammar, kosakata, listening, reading, speaking dan writing level B1 dalam satu tes campuran.

objectives.grammar-vocabulary: Grammar dan kosakata dari semua node B1
objectives.reading-listening: Reading dan listening dengan teks dan audio baru
objectives.writing-speaking: Tugas writing (email serta cerita atau artikel sekitar 100 kata) dan speaking
objectives.pass-mark: Meraih nilai minimal 70 di setiap strand dan rata-rata 80
